scenes.text: Imagine you are driving in the absolute middle of the Sahara Desert where there is nothing but empty sand for hundreds of miles.
But right there, in the dead center of this empty void, stands a single, lonely acacia tree that is the only landmark for leagues.
In nineteen seventy-three, a drunk truck driver managed to do the impossible and crashed directly into this exact tree.
What is the most bizarre coincidence you have ever experienced in your life, let me know below!
